_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the highest-benchmark model + max reasoning effort each hub AI must use, PLUS the verified fallback model each AI switches to when its primary hits usage/quota exhaustion. hub-daemon.ps1 reads this to build spawn flags and to auto-switch model on QUOTA (see fallback_model/fallback_effort + MODELS.md 'usage-exhaustion fallback'). Refreshed daily by the model-benchmark-refresh schedule.
_meta.fallback_contract: On a 429/QUOTA_EXHAUSTED/TerminalQuotaError from an AI's primary model, the daemon retries the SAME cycle once with fallback_model@fallback_effort, then sticks with the fallback for ~6 cycles before re-probing primary. fallback_model MUST be a real model id callable by that CLI (a hallucinated id silently kills the daemon, cf. the grok-4.3 incident) - all fallbacks below were probe-verified 2026-06-15.
_meta.method: hub-upgrade-research workflow (parallel per-provider web search + adversarial cross-verify)

claude.cli_select: Default (recommended) = Opus 4.8  (claude --model opus ; or /model -> Default (recommended) ; then /effort max)
claude.benchmark_basis: Claude Opus 4.8 = the DEFAULT (recommended) model and the most capable one usable on this account. CHANGED 2026-06-17 (Simon): Fable 5 is currently UNAVAILABLE here, so Opus 4.8 is pinned as primary (not fable). Effort scale low|medium|high|xhigh|max; max = no token-spend cap.
claude.caveat: Select via Claude Code 'Default (recommended)' (currently Opus 4.8) or `claude --model opus`; persist max only via env CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max. Interactive Claude Code is flat-rate (not per-token metered). Re-pin to claude-fable-5 ONLY if/when fable becomes available again.

codex.fallback_basis: On usage exhaustion the daemon retries the SAME model at a reduced reasoning tier (medium->low) to cut per-call spend. PRIMARY EFFORT pinned to MEDIUM by Simon (2026-06-17, down from xhigh) to slow premium-pool burn. OBSERVED (account Pro Lite): gpt-5.5 hit a PREMIUM/credit-pool 'usage limit' (retry ~Jul 17) while the standard 5h/weekly pools showed 100% left, and `/status` exposed a SEPARATE 'GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark' pool also at 100%. Lowering effort cuts per-call burn (delays the limit) but does NOT escape an ALREADY-exhausted premium pool. Once exhausted: park this lane + reroute its UI/image work to Claude (flat-rate) until reset, upgrade the plan, or probe-verify `codex -m gpt-5.3-codex-spark` runs BEFORE pinning (never pin an unverified id — grok-4.3 lesson).
codex.benchmark_basis: GPT-5.5 (2026-04-23) = OpenAI's newest frontier model and Codex CLI default; highest OpenAI model usable from Codex CLI. NOTE: no 'gpt-5.5-codex' variant exists — pass -m gpt-5.5. xhigh is the max reasoning tier, but Simon pinned MEDIUM (2026-06-17) to reduce premium-pool burn on the Pro Lite plan.
codex.caveat: Verifier note: GPT-5.5 SWE-bench Verified ~82.6% (below Claude Opus 4.8 88.6% / Fable 5), but it is the best OpenAI model for the Codex lane. Watch for gpt-5.6 (rumored, no official id yet).

grok.fallback_basis: grok-composer-2.5-fast is the grok CLI default and the ONLY other model `grok models` exposes (verified callable 2026-06-15). Used when grok-build hits a usage/quota limit.
grok.benchmark_basis: grok-build is the default + top model actually CALLABLE from the installed grok CLI (grok.com login). `grok models` (verified 2026-06-14) exposes only grok-build (default) + grok-composer-2.5-fast. grok-4.3 is NOT in this build and was rejected at spawn every cycle ('Couldn't set model grok-4.3: Invalid params: unknown'), silently killing the grok daemon. Policy = best model the CLI can actually call, so grok-build.
grok.caveat: Re-pin to a grok-4.x id only after `grok models` shows it. reasoning_effort exposure varies by build; GROK_REASONING_EFFORT may be ignored by grok-build (the model id, not effort, was the blocker).

antigravity.spawn_flags: in-window: agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --model "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)" -i <prompt>  |  daemon (headless): node tools/agy-pty/agy-headless.js <prompt> with env AGY_MODEL="Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)" (needs node + node-pty)
antigravity.fallback_basis: gemini-2.5-flash verified callable via a FLASHOK probe 2026-06-15; the rumored gemini-3.5-flash returns 404 ModelNotFoundError so it is NOT used. Flash is the cheap fallback when 3.1 Pro hits TerminalQuotaError (8h reset).
antigravity.benchmark_basis: Gemini 3.1 Pro (2026-02-19) = Google's #1 model on aggregate (SWE-bench Verified 80.6%, ARC-AGI-2 77.1%, leads 13/16 benchmarks). thinkingLevel HIGH is both the max and the default for 3.1 Pro.
antigravity.caveat: Gemini CLI is DEPRECATED 2026-06-18 — AG migrated to Antigravity CLI (agy). agy's model picker label 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)' encodes max thinking (agy default is 'Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)', so override). DAEMON FIX 2026-06-17: hub-daemon.ps1 AG lane now spawns agy HEADLESS via tools/agy-pty/agy-headless.js (ConPTY) — plain `agy -p`/`gemini -p` emits ~0 bytes under redirected stdout and silently no-op'd the seat (exit 0, empty transcript). Requires `npm install` in tools/agy-pty (node-pty). Gemini 3.5 Flash beats 3.1 Pro on some agentic-coding benchmarks at lower cost (defensible alt).
